name: github
description: Your GitHub notifications (mentions, review requests, assignments, failed runs, security alerts), read through GitHub's own API with a token you create. Read-only: it never marks anything as read.

requires.help: On GitHub open Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Tokens (classic), choose "Generate new token (classic)", tick only the "notifications" box, and save the token (starts with ghp_) in that file. A fine-grained token does not work: GitHub's notifications API only accepts classic tokens. Steps: extractors/github/README.md. For a work account, your employer's rules decide whether you may do this at all.
